10 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, What Tami Hoffman is pointing at {#post}

Tami Hoffman, Director of Public Policy at The Guardian, posted[posted on LinkedInLinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/tami-hoffman_mediapolicy-ai-ugcPost-7520771480264306688-x85h) on 27 October: "This ⬇️ is filling up my inbox. Meta's decision to update its 'commercial terms of use' has got news organisations around the world riled. 90 seconds of your time and I will explain why." The video puts the clause on screen, word by word, and shows Meta's page with the clause highlighted inside the section where a business grants Meta its licences. It is a good way to see it, because the clause is one paragraph among many that businesses accept, often without reading.
